title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Reducing Poverty and Inequality in Malawi’ project in Mchinji, Lilongwe Rural, Balaka, Phalombe and Mulanje districts in Malawi, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will reach 67,500 people directly from 15,000 households from communities ranked lowest on development indicators. Oxfam will partner with the government and 6 national and local NGOs directly to deliver activities which focus on improving access to GBV essential services, increasing participation of women and girls in decision making, increasing institutional responsiveness in promoting gender equality, resilient livelihoods and enhancing household, community and institutional anticipatory preparedness and capacity.IMPACT: IMPACT 3: Institutional systems to prevent and respond to shocks, conflict and crises are more inclusive and better informed by the needs, rights and vulnerabilities of those furthest behind.OUTCOMES: MESO: Local level prevention, mitigation and response structures are increasingly competent, resourced and community led
